Hic namque non fuit contenuis Evangelicis vocibus, apostołorum prædicationibus, quæ utique Patrem, et Filium4et Spiritum saactum sonant: nec dignatus est ita,ut dignum est, credere, quia Pater habet Filium, et Filius vere habet Patrem : sed cum se extendit infelix, et vult inquirere quomodo et qualiter Deus potuit generare, modum non apprehendens, d quia nec com- prehendi potest, ceciditinerroiem,utet Patrem denegaret et Filium.
passages.english: 3. You have asked [me] to say a few things about this heresy which now slanders the catholic faith, that is, about this heresy which arose with Arius as its author. For he was not content with the words of the Gospel and the preaching of the apostles, which indeed proclaim the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit; nor did he deign to believe, as is fitting, that the Father has a Son and the Son truly has a Father. Instead, when the unhappy man overreached himself and wanted to inquire how and in what way God could beget, failing to grasp the manner, since it cannot be comprehended, he fell into error, so that he denied both the Father and the Son.
